Commission for the Arts

5:00

Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.

2.

3.

4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS None.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF Each speaker has three (3) minutes to address the Commission for the Arts. There are no time donations during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the Clerk. Direction to staff to bring back a future agenda item or provide additional information to answer a question requires consent of at least two Commission Members.
6.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announce administrative changes to the agenda in compliance with the Brown Act.
7.

8A. Commission for the Arts Chair and Vice Chair
8B.

Commission for the Arts Annual Work Plan.
1.
Discuss the 2024-25 Work Plan and provide updates on status.
2.
Review ad hoc work on City Council-directed revisions for the Sculpture Loan Program.
3.
Review draft bylaws and vote to recommend to City Council for their approval, pending review by City Attorney.
4.
Review and discuss request from The Encinitas Project for inclusion in the 2025-26 work plan.
5.
Finalize potential items for the 2025-26 Work Plan that align with the Arts Division's work plan and City Council priorities.
6.

7.
Review final outcomes for the 2024-25 Work Plan and vote to approve submission to City Council.
